meta.episodeStory: Two fictional strangers meet at a harbor festival.

continuityBoundary.mustNotHappen: confession, kiss, holding hands, relationship label

sceneAnchors: Dusk: at a crowded harbor festival they recognize each other between two lantern stalls. Film direction: wide establishing shot, full upper bodies visible.
Evening: they walk side by side past food stalls as a ferry leaves the gate. Film direction: medium full shot from a slight side angle.
Blue hour: they sit at the end of a wooden pier talking quietly. Film direction: low-angle pier shot from behind, side profiles, sea horizon.
Night: on the same lantern street they part with a small wave. Film direction: street-level two-shot, visible distance, no physical contact.
